verdict.rationale: Mollie documents payment links that "can for example be attached to an unpaid invoice or shared via email or chat applications", backed by hosted checkout pages. That covers the online-payment part of invoicing, but the evidence does not show Mollie creating, hosting or sending invoices itself; the 'Invoices API' and 'invoice creation' event mentions don't establish customer-facing hosted invoices. Missing for 10: hosted invoice creation and delivery to customers, automatic payment reminders, finance-ops UI workflow for invoicing, independent corroboration.
